about: The Workbench icons of the LMarbles drawer: python3 AMICRADLE/scripts/port_icons.py amiga/icons/icons.json --out amiga/icons (DalsinAI/amicradle). The art is upstream's lmarbles.png. LMarbles-drawer.info is the drawer's own icon, LMarbles.info beside the program. ReadMe.info is also copied for the licence and the manuals; Folder.info for data.
